Running 1.8.0.13 with either key set reaches `JSON is Valid`, so they are undocumented fields rather than obsolete names. playerCountLimit and supportedGameClientTypes, though present as strings in that executable, are rejected by the schema.

notes: This file is the only hand-written file in data/ — everything else there is generated by tools/build-data.mjs from docs/en/.

The invariants above are counts asserted by the documents in prose; the generator warns when the tables disagree with them.
